fact: UNESCO's contribution to the 46th Universal Periodic Review states that no access to information laws have been adopted in the Comoros and names no draft; the document gives no event date, so this is dated to its publication month, January 2026.

UNESCWA's December 2025 Comoros anti-corruption profile says transparency is not yet clearly defined in the legislative framework and recommends developing a law guaranteeing the right to access information, so none is in place.
